headsets.title: Headsets
headsets.empty: Pair a headset on Devices to download immersive videos.

failure.checksum_mismatch: The file was corrupted in transfer. Try again.

prepDialog.description: Downloads take a while and stop when the headset goes to sleep. Set up the headset first so the download can finish.
prepDialog.chargingDescription: Plug the headset in and leave it connected until the download finishes.

sleepPath.sleepMode: From the Sleep mode dropdown, select 4 hours

storageDialog.title: Not enough free space
storageDialog.description: This headset has {{free}} free and the video is {{size}}. The download will fail unless space is freed.
